pr_body:

https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-release/release.md#issuepr-kind-label

#### What type of PR is this?

<!--
Add one of the following kinds:
/kind bug
/kind cleanup
/kind documentation
/kind feature
/kind design

Optionally add one or more of the following kinds if applicable:
/kind api-change
/kind deprecation
/kind failing-test
/kind flake
/kind regression
-->

/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Now, there is `Apply()` function for each resource on client-go fake clientset.

For example: https://github.com/kubernetes/client-go/blob/ac207faedfb64acd5b99a2fb309b7044918b4dda/kubernetes/typed/core/v1/fake/fake_node.go#L138-L157

But we cannot use serverside-apply with this `Apply()` because ApplyPatchType is not supported in testing.ObjectReaction() 
When we call Apply() with new resource and exist resource, each tell us different error message.

```
# create new resource(name=nodename)
nodes "nodename" not found

# update exist resource
PatchType is not supported 
```

`not found ` error confuses users. These must be same errors.

---

This PR adds non-supported PatchType information to error message.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

-->
Fixes #103816

issue_context.title: client-go: cannot create/update resource with server-side apply on client-go fake clientset
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->

Hello team.

#### What happened:

https://github.com/kubernetes/client-go/blob/ac207faedfb64acd5b99a2fb309b7044918b4dda/kubernetes/typed/core/v1/fake/fake_node.go#L138-L157

FakeNodes has Apply method, but we cannot create/update resource with server-side apply with this method.
And creating new resource and updating exist resource have different error message.

```
# create new resource
 nodes "nodename" not found

# update exist resource
PatchType is not supported 
```

#### What you expected to happen:

(1) support ApplyPatchType or (2) creating new resource makes the same error as updating (= `PatchType is not supported`)


#### How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible):

apply resource with fake clientset

#### Anything else we need to know?:

#### Environment:
- client-go version: latest
comments:
I'd like to take this issue
/assign

I have no good idea to implement server-side apply logic on PatchActionImpl to support ApplyPatchType 😢
For now, I changed the error message on creating new resource with serverside apply. #103821
We've discussed that with @jpbetz before. Not sure that's something we want to do.

> We've discussed that with Joe Betz before. Not sure that's something we want to do.

See our [earlier discussion about this](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/99462#discussion_r590548928) and [the doc we wrote on the topic](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ipi1sZd5rvPvplX_TV74gGOtFWJTf9N0qKnH2-rcI4s/edit#heading=h.io39zc1z1m28) for more detail.

Hello.
OK, So this issue is duplicated with #99953. I'll close it with #103821, thanks
I don't think https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/103821 closes this since it just makes the error better.

Hi @howardjohn 
We can see two problems in this issue.

- fake clientset doesn't support server-side apply
- for the current situation, error message is not appropriate because user cannot know fake clientset doesn't support server-side apply from error message.

And the first one is duplicated with #99953. So I think it is ok to close this issue with #103821, because the PR will fix the second one.
Aha, #99953 was closed because of non-update. I'll reopen it.
